source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: After over two decades without an elected students' union, Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) is set to return to campus democracy, with the university committing to complete the union constitution by May 15, 2027, and hold elections by Aug 27, 2027. The last union election was held in 2005, reports Sugandha Jha.The breakthrough came late Thursday after registrar Md Mahtab Alam Rizvi visited the protest site around 9pm and held talks with the agitating students, bringing the 18-day hunger strike to an end on the university's 106th Foundation Day. The registrar's order, issued after the discussions, addressed the protesters' central demand for a time-bound roadmap to restore elected student representation. It also directed the withdrawal of disciplinary action linked to the stir.Polls at Jamia likely in Aug next year, 18-day hunger strike endsThe five hunger strikers ended their fast with juice offered by the registrar. This date will be in accordance with the guidelines set forth by the Lyngdoh Committee regulations.
